metadata.description: An AI-powered, child-friendly learning companion that turns learning into an interactive journey.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

designSystem.title: Small hands. Big discoveries.
designSystem.intro: A playful, consistent visual language for exploring, thinking and trying again. This working gallery uses the project's real design tokens.
designSystem.note: Design specimens, not production learning content. The final mascot and lesson contract are still open decisions.

colors.title: Our colors have jobs
colors.description: Purple leads. Teal reassures. Gold celebrates discoveries. Pink brings character. Color never carries feedback alone.

typography.title: Type with a smile
typography.heading: Every question is an adventure.
typography.body: Clear, friendly words make each next step easy to understand.

buttons.title: Buttons you can almost feel
buttons.description: One strong primary action per moment. A generous touch target, clear text and a visible pressed state.
buttons.initial: Choose a button to try its response.

cards.title: Three paths, one welcoming world
cards.description: These are non-clickable layout specimens. Real navigation cards must be links with meaningful destinations.
cards.continueDescription: Pick up right where you stopped.

feedback.title: Feedback without fear
feedback.description: Response language names the next step, not the child's worth. Incorrect answers never look like system errors.
feedback.hintBody: Tap each apple once and watch the basket.

lesson.title: A lesson should feel like play
lesson.description: Try the little counting scene. It works with a mouse, touch, Enter and Space—dragging isn't required.
lesson.prompt: Can you put three apples in the basket?
lesson.guideText: Tap an apple. I'll count with you!
lesson.completeBody: You counted them one by one. Nicely done!

designSystem.footer: Make the next interaction easy to understand, and make trying again feel safe.
